transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling persistently down and sad for a really long time now. It's been going on constantly for about two years and four months, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy, depressed mood.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, hyper, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. My mood has just been consistently low and I feel completely drained all the time. I've never had those kinds of high-energy periods.
During these past two years, have you ever had a period of two months or more where your mood returned to normal and you felt like your usual self?

No, I haven't had any break like that at all. This heavy low mood and emptiness have been completely constant for the entire two years and four months. I might have had a fleeting good day here or there, but my mood has never returned to normal for any real length of time.
Alongside this low mood, have you lost interest or pleasure in almost all activities that you used to enjoy?

I haven't necessarily lost interest in everything, but it's more that I feel a constant sense of emptiness and emotional numbness. It just feels like my emotions are completely dulled, so I can't really experience pleasure or feel like myself.
Along with this low mood, have you been experiencing feelings of hopelessness, or feeling like things will never get better?

Yes, I feel completely hopeless about the future. I have this constant belief that things will never get better, and I've just resigned myself to the idea that nothing I do will change my situation. It feels like I'm stuck in this dark place forever.
How has your sleep been during this time? Have you been having trouble sleeping, or perhaps sleeping much more than usual?

My sleep is completely disrupted; I often struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly, and wake up too early, but other times I end up sleeping for excessively long hours. I also suffer from distressing nightmares almost every night. No matter how much I sleep, I always wake up feeling completely exhausted and unrefreshed.
Have you ever experienced or witnessed an extremely traumatic, terrifying, or life-threatening event in your past?

No, I haven't ever experienced or witnessed any extremely traumatic or life-threatening events in my past. My life has been relatively quiet, so my low mood doesn't seem to stem from any specific trauma like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight during this time, such as eating much less or overeating?
I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or weight. My eating habits have remained mostly normal throughout this time.

Yes, my concentration has been really poor. I find it very difficult to pay attention or maintain focus on daily activities, like following a conversation, reading, or even watching television. My mind just feels too foggy to stay on track.
How has your self-esteem been? Have you been feeling like a failure, or experiencing a lot of self-doubt and guilt?

I wouldn't say I've been feeling like a failure or experiencing a lot of guilt. My self-esteem feels relatively normal, as my struggle is much more about the constant sadness and hopelessness than feeling bad about myself.
